Name: test_view_cart_with_added_products[chromium]
Description:
Test: View cart with added products
    Jira Story: QA-4 - View Cart Contents
    Type: Positive
    
    Preconditions: User is on the website and cart contains at least one product
    
    Steps:
    1. Add a product to cart
    2. Click on the cart icon
    3. Verify cart page opens and displays list of all added products 
       with correct names, prices, quantities, and images

Name: test_view_cart_with_multiple_products[chromium]
Description:
Test: View cart with multiple added products
    Jira Story: QA-4 - View Cart Contents
    Type: Positive
    
    Preconditions: User is on the website and cart contains multiple products
    
    Steps:
    1. Add multiple products to cart
    2. Click on the cart icon
    3. Verify cart page displays all added products with correct details

Name: test_add_multiple_different_products_to_cart[chromium]
Description:
QA-3: Add Item to Cart
    Test: Add multiple different products to cart
    Verify that user can add multiple different products to cart
    and cart badge updates correctly for each addition.
